labels.cart_drawer_auto_open: Open drawer after adding to cart

info.colors_intro: Choose preset named schemes for the whole store, or one custom palette. The store default applies everywhere unless a section chooses its own colours.
info.colors_preset: Named schemes are shared across the theme. Set Store colour scheme for the usual site-wide palette. Header and footer can use that default or override with a section-specific scheme (see each section → Colour scheme source).
info.colors_custom: These colours apply site-wide. The preset scheme editor further down is ignored while Custom is selected.
info.typography_intro: Curated mode loads Google Fonts (preconnect + display=swap) into --cs-font-heading, --cs-font-body, and --cs-font-mono. Custom mode uses Shopify’s font_picker and @font-face (Shop fonts and Google in the library). Global colours are under Colors, not here.
info.typography_custom: Heading, body, and code use these fonts. They map to --cs-font-heading, --cs-font-body, and --cs-font-mono.
info.typography_preset_research: Presets: Arial (system stack, no Google Fonts), Neutral (versatile sans), Vision (Fraunces + Manrope; Fira Code mono), Technology (mono-led + Inter). To add or change a slug, update config/settings_schema.json, snippets/font-pairing-link.liquid, font-pairing-loader.liquid, snippets/css-variables.liquid, and src/styles/base/_fonts.scss. Non-Arial hrefs stay on fonts.googleapis.com.
info.search_scope: Product-only search uses Shopify’s type=product parameter. Articles and pages are excluded.
info.header_menu_nested: Add nested links in Online Store → Navigation (up to two levels under a top-level item). On large screens they appear as dropdowns and flyouts; in the mobile drawer they expand in place.
info.sticky_header: Controls whether the header stays visible when scrolling.
info.header_color_scheme_solid: The colour scheme used after the visitor scrolls past the hero, when the header has a solid background.
info.header_color_scheme_transparent: The colour scheme used at the top of the page while the header overlaps a hero section. Choose a light scheme for dark hero images, or a dark scheme for light ones.
info.logo_retina: Optional 2× version for sharp display on high-DPI screens. Upload at double the intended display size.
info.logo_width_retina: Display width of the logo. Upload your retina logo at twice this width in pixels.
info.logo_mobile: Shown on screens narrower than 768px. Falls back to the main logo if not set.
info.logo_mobile_retina: Optional 2× version of the mobile logo. Upload at double the intended mobile display size.
info.logo_mobile_width: Display width of the mobile logo.
info.desktop_header_layout: Large screens only. Phone and tablet still use the menu drawer and top bar.
info.size_guide_default_image: Shown in the size guide modal when a product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield. Upload a size chart (e.g. PNG or SVG).
info.social_media: Add your profile URLs once; they can appear in the footer, header contact panel, and other theme areas that support social links.
info.section_color_scheme_source: Default follows Theme settings → Color schemes → Store colour scheme. Custom uses the colour scheme(s) you choose below for this section only.
info.font_size_base: Sets the body text size. Heading levels and theme CSS variables (e.g. --font-size-lg) scale from this value using a fixed ratio. Individual components may still use their own sizes until they adopt those tokens.

font_pairing.arial: Arial — system sans (heading + body; no web fonts)
font_pairing.neutral: Neutral — Plus Jakarta Sans + DM Sans (global)

desktop_header_layout.logo_nav_actions: Logo left — menu and cart/icons on the right
desktop_header_layout.logo_nav_center_actions: Logo left — menu centred — cart/icons right
desktop_header_layout.nav_logo_center_actions: Menu left — logo centred — cart/icons right
desktop_header_layout.two_row: Two rows — logo and cart/icons on top, menu below

annotated.name: Annotated
annotated.richtext_info: Use shortcodes around words or phrases (see the usage note below). Hand-drawn emphasis appears when this block scrolls into view.
annotated.editor_description: This block is for storytelling and highlights: normal paragraphs with optional Rough Notation effects on selected phrases. Effects respect reduced-motion preferences.
annotated.editor_usage: Shortcodes — [underline]…[/underline], [circle]…[/circle], [highlight]…[/highlight], [box]…[/box], [strike]…[/strike], [bracket]…[/bracket], [crossed-off]…[/crossed-off]. Optional colour: [highlight color=#E8593C]…[/highlight]. Opening and closing tags must match; keep nesting simple if you mix bold, italics, or links inside a marked phrase.

header.drawer_social_heading_info: URLs come from Theme settings → Social media.
header.drawer_localization_info: Only appears when your store offers multiple countries/regions or languages. Country and language show side by side when both are available. Icons are visible; the text fields below are for screen readers. Selection changes apply immediately.
header.drawer_localization_field_sr_heading_inf: Used as the accessible name for this control (screen readers). Icons are shown visually.
header.drawer_account_info: Renders Shopify’s customer account control (same as the header account icon). Uses the Customer account menu setting in this section. Only appears when customer accounts are enabled for your store.
header.drawer_account_signed_out_button_info: Shown on the mobile menu control before a customer signs in. After sign-in, their avatar appears instead.
header.drawer_utilities_order_note: Mobile menu (bottom of the panel): Social → Country/language → Account. Block order in the editor does not change this. Rich text blocks (if added) appear after those.
header.drawer_slot_info: Applies to rich text blocks only. Controls styling; all rich text appears after Social, Country/language, and Account in the mobile menu.

header_top_bar.localization_menu_info: Choose what shoppers can change. Each option appears only if your store supports multiple countries/regions or multiple languages (Markets / languages settings). Uses the same pattern as Store contact info: click the bar label to open a panel (sheet on small screens).
header_top_bar.localization_menu_label_info: Shown on the top bar before opening the menu. Supports bold, italic, and links. Leave blank to use the default label.
header_top_bar.localization_field_heading_info: Leave blank to use the default.
header_top_bar.localization_trigger_icon_info: Optional icon before the button text. Colour uses Icon colour when set, otherwise the trigger colour.
header_top_bar.localization_menu_description_info: Short notice shown at the top of the panel (like a tip for shoppers). Supports bold, italic, and links. Long text scrolls inside the notice.
header_top_bar.name: Top bar
header_top_bar.separator_info: Adds a vertical divider between items on desktop.
header_top_bar.rt_max_width_info: Set to 0 to use full available width.
header_top_bar.si_label_info: Text shown in the top bar. Click to open the panel (bottom sheet on small screens).
header_top_bar.si_social_theme_settings_info: Link URLs are set once in Theme settings → Social media (shared with the footer and other areas).
header_top_bar.color_accent_info: Used for focus rings and the subscribe button. Leave empty to inherit the theme accent.

scrolling_promotion.name: Scrolling promotion
scrolling_promotion.speed_info: Seconds for one full loop. Lower values scroll faster.

main_collection.hero_video_info: Upload a video. When set, it replaces the collection image in the hero (fallback image is ignored until video is cleared).

filter_layout.label: Filter layout
filter_layout.info: Offcanvas, inline, and overlay control how the filter panel opens. Sidebar shows filters beside the grid from the xl breakpoint up; below that, filters use the inline toggle pattern.
filter_layout.sidebar: Left sidebar (desktop); collapsible on smaller screens

blog.name: Blog
blog.hero_video_info: Upload a video. Overrides the hero image when set.
blog.animate_info: Items fade in with a stagger effect on page load.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave blank to use the default label for this block.

info.overlay_softness: Adds a subtle background wash on the text side for legibility. 0% is off.
info.parallax_scroll: Background media moves slightly as the page scrolls (desktop only; disabled when reduced motion is on).

slide.name: Slide
slide.color_scheme_info: Used when Colour scheme is set to Custom. Otherwise the slide uses the theme’s global colour scheme.
slide.background_media_info: Choose a still image or a video file hosted in your store.
slide.image_info: When using video, this image is the poster frame before playback (recommended).
slide.video_info: Shown when Background type is Video. Use an MP4 from Shopify Files.
slide.heading: Heading
slide.content_overlay_enable_info: Adds a colour layer between the background and text for better contrast.
slide.content_overlay_coverage_info: Text column only tints behind the copy. Full slide covers the entire hero.
slide.content_color_override_info: Applies to this slide’s eyebrow, heading, body, text links, and primary/secondary actions. The slide’s chosen colour scheme (default or custom) still controls the overall palette when overrides are not set, or for anything these fields do not cover (e.g. focus rings use the scheme accent).
slide.content_color_link: Text link (body, heading links, and secondary action)
slide.content_color_btn_bg_info: Use a transparent or semi-transparent value for the outline look. Solid fills for a pill button.

info.autoplay_pause_on_hover: Pauses auto-advance while the mouse is over the slider (touch devices are unchanged).
info.min_height_vh: Height is based on the viewport—handy for tall banners.
info.full_width: Off keeps this section the same width as standard content. On goes edge to edge. With centered slides, “Default” width still follows your Page width setting.
info.slide_centered_auto: Centres the active slide and peeks the neighbours. Uses slide motion (fade is off here). Turns on the slide width options below.
info.slide_item_max_width: Only when centered slides is on. “Default” matches Page width; “Custom” uses a fixed width you set.
info.slide_item_max_width_px: Shown when width is Custom: 300–2300 px, in steps of 20.
info.initial_slide_index: Counts from 1. Too high a number uses the last slide. With JavaScript off, the first slide shows.

slide.name: Slide
slide.image_mobile_info: Shown below 768px. Falls back to the main image when empty.
slide.overlay_coverage_info: Full slide tints the whole image. Behind text only adds a bottom gradient for legibility.
slide.content_position_info: Where this slide’s headline and buttons sit over the image.
slide.heading: Heading
slide.copy_color_override_info: Per-slide colours for eyebrow, heading, body, links, and primary button. The section colour scheme still applies elsewhere (e.g. focus rings use the scheme accent). Leave colours as set or clear in the editor to fall back to the scheme.
slide.copy_color_link: Text link (body links and secondary action)
slide.copy_color_btn_bg_info: Use transparent or semi-transparent for an outline style; solid for a filled button.
slide.slide_radius_info: Rounds this slide’s image and overlay. Separate from the section frame settings.

product_slider.name: Product slider

labels.heading: Heading
labels.full_width_info: Section background fills the browser width. Content stays in the page column.
labels.background_color_info: Clear uses the colour scheme. Otherwise fills the full section area.
labels.border_color_info: Clear uses the colour scheme border. Used when width is greater than 0.

product_slider.color_scheme_info: Used when Colour scheme is set to Custom. Otherwise the section uses the theme’s global colour scheme.

feature_grid.name: Feature grid

labels.heading: Heading
labels.columns_info: One column on small screens; then follows your choice.
labels.full_width_info: Section background fills the browser width. Content stays in the page column.
labels.background_color_info: Clear uses the colour scheme. Otherwise fills the full section area.
labels.border_color_info: Clear uses the colour scheme border. Used when width is greater than 0.

feature_grid.color_scheme_info: Used when Colour scheme is set to Custom. Otherwise the section uses the theme’s global colour scheme.

feature.name: Feature
feature.image_alt_info: For accessibility. Leave empty if decorative.
feature.title: Title
feature.open_in_new_tab: Open link in a new tab

main_product.name: Product
main_product.layout_info: Reorder blocks to change the product page; app blocks follow block order and temporarily close the product form so app markup is not nested inside it. Description, specs, and nested accordions use the **Product tabs** section.
main_product.layout_info_v2: Reorder blocks to change the product page; app blocks follow block order and temporarily close the product form so app markup is not nested inside it. Use **Divider** for a line between blocks, **Text** for rich text, and **Accordion** for collapsible content. Description, specs, and tab accordions use **Product tabs**.
main_product.size_guide_pdp_info: Optional size chart for this product template. When set, and the product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield, this image is used **instead of** the theme’s global size chart. Product metafield content still takes priority. Leave empty to use the global or metafield only.
main_product.size_guide_image_info: Overrides the global theme size chart for this product template when the product has no `custom.size_guide` metafield.
main_product.gallery_layout_info: Beside: vertical thumbnail strip on the left on large screens. Below: horizontal thumbnails under the main image. Main only: large carousel with arrows/keyboard, no strip. Stack: all images listed (variant changes scroll to the featured image).
main_product.pdp_divider_spacing_info: Extra vertical padding around the rule so neighbouring blocks read as separate groups.
main_product.pdp_accordion_icon_info: Optional small image shown beside the label (e.g. simple line icon). Shown at a fixed size in the summary row.

product_tabs.name: Product tabs
product_tabs.intro: Description tabs, rich text tabs, spec rows, and nested accordions apply to this product. Choose **Layout** for top tabs, a left-hand tab rail on large screens, or an accordion. App blocks stack below. Add below **Product** on the product template.
product_tabs.tabs_layout_info: **Top** — horizontal tabs above content. **Tab nav left** — vertical labels in a left column from tablet/desktop (horizontal tabs on small screens). **Accordion** — each tab becomes a collapsible section; browsers that support grouped `details` keep one open at a time.
product_tabs.content_max_width_info: Maximum width of the tab content and app blocks inside this section (centered).
product_tabs.tab_description_heading_info: Leave blank to use the default label for this block type (see theme language → Products).
product_tabs.tab_rte_heading_info: Leave blank to use the default label for this block type (see theme language → Products).
product_tabs.tab_rte_include_specs_info: When enabled, every Spec row block in this section is rendered inside this tab.
product_tabs.tab_rte_empty_message_info: Optional. Shown when this tab has no rich text and no spec table content (when specs are included). Leave blank to use the theme default message.

footer.name: Footer
footer.color_scheme_custom_intro: When source is Custom, pick a scheme for this footer.
footer.tagline_info: Optional short line under the shop name.
footer.show_social: Show social icons when URLs are set
footer.social_urls_theme_settings: Profile URLs are set in Theme settings → Social media.
footer.copyright_note_info: Short text after the shop name (optional).
